meta.generated: dashboard-automation compute core (every legacy metric verified vs the historical KQF workbook)
meta.universe_note: Top 100 & the ~90%-cap basket are rebuilt daily from market cap; NSE500 TR is the benchmark.
meta.source: Bloomberg prices/mktcap/volume + broker quarterly fundamentals (Aditya Birla).
caveats: DESCRIPTIVE market-pulse context, not a forward buy/sell signal.

The valuation '90% Mkt Cap' basket (fundamentals-restricted cumulative cap, ≈86-90% coverage, legacy construction) is a DIFFERENT member set from the breadth tab's '90% cap' — labels reused historically.
Fundamentals are lagged one quarter; dates early in a calendar quarter may reference a quarter close to its filing deadline (mild look-ahead, shared with the legacy engine).
Multibagger bands are RETURN thresholds (+200%/+500%/+1000%), historically mislabelled '2X/5X/10X'.
'Stocks near ATH' uses corrected per-stock listing-date eligibility (the legacy Excel ran a looser panel-wide cutoff; the Excel keeps the legacy series for continuity).
Growth-breadth counts profit->loss as a failure (not censored) and blanks buckets with <20 measured names.

plots.title: Aggregate P/E
plots.desc: Cap-weighted P/E of the basket = 1 / aggregate earnings-yield (trailing PAT lagged 1 quarter). Note: '90% Mkt Cap' here is the legacy KQF cumulative-cap basket (fundamentals-restricted; ≈86-90% of total cap — it excludes the single largest name from the 90% threshold). It is NOT the same member set as the breadth tab's '90% cap'. Reconciled to the historical workbook to 1e-15.

plots.title: Aggregate P/B
plots.desc: Cap-weighted P/B of the basket = 1 / aggregate book-yield.

plots.title: Earnings yield
plots.desc: Aggregate trailing earnings yield (PAT/MktCap) of the basket.

plots.title: Book yield
plots.desc: Aggregate book yield (Networth/MktCap) of the basket.

plots.title: Valuation breadth: % of stocks expensive
plots.desc: Share of stocks with P/E > 50x and > 100x (trailing PAT). [AUDIT F1: loss-making / no-earnings names have an undefined P/E and are NOT counted as expensive — so froth is understated in earnings recessions; read alongside the value-breadth and ATH panels.]

plots.title: Value breadth: % cheap & profitable (P/B<1 & ROE>10%)
plots.desc: Share of stocks trading below book with ROE above 10% — deep-value-with-quality breadth.

plots.title: Median ROE
plots.desc: Median return on equity (trailing PAT / Networth) across the basket.

plots.title: Aggregate capex growth (3-yr CAGR)
plots.desc: 3-yr CAGR of aggregate capex (annual, broker capex negated).

plots.title: Aggregate sales growth ex-financials (3-yr CAGR)
plots.desc: 3-yr CAGR of aggregate trailing sales, ex-financials.

plots.title: % of firms adding debt faster than equity (3-yr)
plots.desc: Share of firms whose 3-YEAR change in total debt exceeded their 3-year change in equity (a cumulative leverage build, not a 1-yr impulse). Absolute-rupee test over the fundamentals universe (survivor-inclusive). [AUDIT B3: corrected label — the engine uses a 3-yr window.]

plots.title: Participation: % of stocks beating NSE500 TR
plots.desc: Share of stocks with positive alpha vs the NSE500 total-return index over 3m/6m/1Y. [AUDIT F2/F3: stock returns are price-return (ex-dividend) vs a TR benchmark, so the hurdle is ~1-1.5%/yr high (participation biased slightly low, more at 1Y); the all-univ series includes short-history names. Use the 90%-cap series as the cleaner read.]

plots.title: Liquidity concentration: stocks = 90% of value traded
plots.desc: Breadth of trading value. The % series (default) = share of the universe accounting for 90% of one day's value traded — comparable over time. The raw count conflates de-concentration with a growing universe. [AUDIT: single month-end day (not a 20-day average despite the legacy column name).]

plots.title: Multibaggers: % of 90%-cap stocks up ≥200% / ≥500% / ≥1000% (5-yr low)
plots.desc: Share of 90%-cap members whose price is up at least +200% / +500% / +1000% from their trailing ~5-yr low (i.e. ≈3× / 6× / 11× the low). [AUDIT B2: the legacy Excel labels these '2X/5X/10X', but the test is on the RETURN (gain>2/5/10), so a '2X' name has actually tripled — relabelled here to the true return thresholds.] Names with <5-yr history use their available low.

plots.title: Stocks near all-time-high (corrected eligibility)
plots.desc: % of 90%-cap stocks trading above 99% of their own price history. Uses correct per-stock listing-date eligibility (the legacy Excel used a looser panel-wide cutoff — see AUDIT_FINDINGS F1).

plots.title: Market-cap share: Top 100 & 90%-cap as % of all
plots.desc: Concentration: Top-100 and 90%-cap baskets as a share of total market cap.

plots.title: Profitable market-cap share
plots.desc: Share of Top-100 / 90%-cap market cap that is in profit-making companies.

gb.note: Breadth = % of companies in the cap-rank bucket whose trailing PAT (4Q=12m or 12Q=36m) grew faster than the threshold, 1y or 3y-CAGR. A company is measured whenever its PRIOR-period base was positive; a profit->loss deterioration counts as a FAILURE (not excluded). Undefined (excluded) only when the prior base was <=0. Buckets need >=20 measured names (else blank). Fundamentals lagged one quarter.

Breadth = % of companies in the cap-rank bucket whose trailing Sales (4Q=12m or 12Q=36m) grew faster than the threshold, 1y or 3y-CAGR. A company is measured whenever its PRIOR-period base was positive; a profit->loss deterioration counts as a FAILURE (not excluded). Undefined (excluded) only when the prior base was <=0. Buckets need >=20 measured names (else blank). Fundamentals lagged one quarter; financials excluded (interest income != sales).
